items.title: Acute limb ischemia and aortic aneurysm have only adjacent emergency MCC evidence
items.summary: Targeted canonical registry searches found no dedicated acute limb ischemia or aneurysm objective. Objective 109-15 explicitly names acute limb ischemia but is trauma-framed; objective 9-2 supports shock from acute aortic catastrophe but does not name aneurysm. Both citations remain WEAK with requires_scope_review=true rather than being overstated.
items.recommended_action: Recheck after an MCC registry refresh; keep scope limited to recognition, initial stabilization, and urgent vascular referral.
